verdict.rationale: Bevy is a code-first engine: projects are ordinary Rust/cargo projects and need no editor. Its own Scene system can create, save, load and hot-reload ECS worlds, and Asset V2 adds .meta files, so a project is largely made of text files that fit normal git workflows. The evidence never says scene files are diffable or mergeable text, and there is no collaboration tooling, so this credit is inferred and thin. Missing for 10: documented text-based (diffable) scene format, merge guidance or tooling for scenes, built-in multi-user collaboration features, hands-on team/VCS corroboration.
